# f5xc_k8s_cluster_role (Data Source)

K8s Cluster Role is K8s ClusterRole object, which represents set of permissions for<br>user, group or service account to which this role is assigned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: K8s Cluster Role - Full

data "f5xc_k8s_cluster_role" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role.example.namespace
}
```
